caption: A cream-colored candle stands centered in the lower frame against a black background, its pale body showing an uneven melted rim and a small right-edge notch. A short dark wick rises into a tall teardrop flame whose bright white-yellow core is ringed by a thin blue base zone. The flame flickers continuously, its height and brightness shifting subtly while the blue base grows more or less prominent, the solid candle staying fixed relative to the frame edges. In the latter part a faint horizontal band appears along the bottom edge and grows lighter and more opaque. Within it the title 'Inner peace guided meditation' and the URL 'WWW.ROSALEAH.COM' fade to crisp lettering, holding visible through the final frame.
